sourceNote: Recovered from the last deployed Safe Cracker preview; one whitespace-only runtime line was cleaned. Supporting generated SVG and recordings were rebuilt from the unchanged repository sources and matched that deployment.
changes: Reserve pointer-housing clearance below the digital display at desktop, mobile, and compact-mobile sizes.

Use the real board in waiting and ready screens with instructions above and a tip bar below; enlarge matched progress tiles; soften metal shading and bolt the pointer mount to the dial rim; stop the completed timer.

Restore scratched steel with even shading; add a bank vault PNG and brass instrument panels; remove opponent status; improve dial numerals and recessed step buttons; use authoritative 60-second rounds.

Seat the safe into the vault wall with warm steel and contact seams; remove text shadows and condensed control fonts; add a large responsive results report with authoritative codes, progress and rematch actions.
Raise the safe board 24px on desktop and 16px on phones; rebuild the bank with slate-blue painted framing, blue-gray steel, silver deposit boxes and gray stone, with matching UI materials.
Raise the safe above the floor on desktop and mobile; replace the door surface with a detailed brushed-steel PNG while preserving all live hardware and opening animations.

Match scratched gunmetal to a wall-only bank room; keep the safe mounted through completion, sequence latch release before the door swing, and preserve fast dial input with one stage-scoped queued check.
Replace pebbled safe grain with smooth dark machined steel and fine straight scratches, preserving the slate color; shade the stationary frame as a recessed jamb.

Restore warm interior light and reflected glow, use a controlled hinge perspective, and allow a 500ms open-safe hold before the win report. Validate result timing, polling continuity, and reduced motion.
Open the safe outward with a weighted 1500ms swing, visible 3D steel edge planes, and localized golden cavity light reflected onto the door rim, thickness and frame.
Restore the earlier restrained 15-degree outward opening and its detent-like timing, retaining the new steel texture, physical door thickness and localized golden lighting.
Brighten the golden cavity and reflected light at the existing opening angle; remove obsolete image/dial versions and prime both audio banks only when Safe Cracker is selected or restored.
Decode current wall, door, and dial before reveal; retain all authoritative guards with a 500 ms verification interval and stop expired bot rematch retries.
Removed ten unreferenced recording-fragment experiments. Original source chunks remain because the audio rebuild script uses them; current SVG hardware textures remain referenced by CSS.

Paint drag rotation once per frame using cached geometry; preserve the visible angle on interrupted turns, shorten the settle, and keep numerals steady. Replace the floating index and housing with one bolted steel fixture; include it in decoded-art preparation.

Reject stale local/deferred views after completion; deliver only revision-confirmed terminal snapshots during drag without replacing the board. Show the checked digit and green feedback for 240ms before the existing door/light sequence, hide the pending result from focus/announcements, preserve progress nodes and use local opacity lighting instead of animated safe filters.

Render the unchanged detailed dial artwork from a decoded 640px PNG; retain SVG as rebuild/validation source. Gate countdown scans to countdown state, and include bounded, local drag frame timing in copied game diagnostics. No idle frame loop or gameplay/network changes.
